missing.why: Blood Well was removed in his 2018 rework; he has no resource bar now. Not missing.
Players may assume Flow like Yasuo, but Yone has no resource bar. Not missing.

disputable.why: He pays Health for abilities; players may argue his Bloodthirst bar is a counter, not a resource.
His bar shows stored Shield; players may argue it isn't a resource.

aliases.why: Players drop the apostrophe; check it already normalises.

fun.why: Energy ninjas come instantly, but Fury, Grit, Courage and Ferocity reward players who know resource bars; few will name all 16.

champion:Kennen.why: Often forgotten among the Kinkou but still common.

champion:Tryndamere.why: Fury bar driving his crit is well known.

champion:Rumble.why: Heat is named in the Prompt.

champion:Shyvana.why: Fury for dragon form, moderately known.

champion:Sett.why: Grit is remembered as a W mechanic, not a bar.

champion:Kled.why: Courage is known by Kled fans.

champion:RekSai.why: Players often think she is simply manaless and forget Fury.

champion:Ambessa.why: Newer champion; her Energy is little known.

champion:Vladimir.why: Vlad players know the Bloodthirst bar; others think he just pays Health.

champion:Mordekaiser.why: His shield bar is seen every game but rarely thought of as a resource.

gemCandidates.why: Fury is easy to forget; 'oh, of course' when revealed. The suggested pick clears the threshold.
Grit is a resource bar players see every game but rarely think of as one.
Energy on a non-ninja is a fun surprise, though fewer players know her kit.
